May 8, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Wilsey Asset Management Inc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 2.71% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wilsey Asset Management Inc bought 2,257 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 85,594 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $14.49M, up from 83,337 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wilsey Asset Management Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $939.50 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.72% or $1.33 $185.16. About 40.89M shares traded or 11.18% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
